نتحاول (form VI)
# نَتَحَاوَلُ (nataḥāwalu) /na.ta.ħaː.wa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَحَاوَلَ (taḥāwala)
# نَتَحَاوَلَ (nataḥāwala) /na.ta.ħaː.wa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَحَاوَلَ (taḥāwala)
# نَتَحَاوَلْ (nataḥāwal) /na.ta.ħaː.wal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَحَاوَلَ (taḥāwala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
